product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving provides an all-in-one, AI-powered business-management platform for fitness, wellness, and beauty businesses to manage operations, bookings, payments, clients, and marketing.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage describes the platform and identifies the businesses it serves.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and prices are listed, alongside an enterprise contact option.

named_customers.notes: These names appear among the customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The LinkedIn company profile identifies Thornhill, Ontario as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists 2012 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows business, fitness, release-note, and press content, but does not show at least two engineer-authored posts explaining product engineering, infrastructure, architecture, ML, data, or open source.

public_docs.notes: The homepage links to a public help center and developer portal; the portal contains multiple guides, tutorials, API references, and other documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is titled AI Marketing Automation Specialist and includes applying AI tools to marketing; it is a marketing-oriented AI role, not a research or ML-engineering position.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public developer documentation, AI product announcements and blog results, and available security/privacy search results; WellnessLiving describes CAASI and its own AI features but does not publicly identify the underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: WellnessLiving says it undergoes SOC 2 audits and makes its SOC 2 Type II report available on request, describes HIPAA audits/compliant systems, and says it supports PCI-DSS compliance with limited scope. The framework attributes ISO 27001 certifications to AWS, not WellnessLiving; GDPR was not claimed as a WellnessLiving certification.

last_funding.notes: The reported total comprises a $46 million minority investment and $20 million of growth financing.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported latest funding was in August 2022, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive posting is live, displays Apply Now, and is dated November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: WellnessLiving announced the CAASI Chat and Phone Agents on July 28, 2026, within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found no verifiable C-level or VP join/departure announcement in the period, but the available company profile does not provide a complete current leadership roster sufficient to support a negative answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named on WellnessLiving’s integrations/partners page; LenzVU is identified there as a CRM.
